fields.script:
## Format
Micro vlog, about 40 seconds. Vertical, 4K 30fps. Lock exposure and focus on your face. Face a window. Don't show inbox contents, Rexona documents or readable work screens.

## Script
**0:00–0:03 — To camera, close, coffee in hand, morning light. Start talking straight away.**
"Monday. Honest truth? Work feels overwhelming right now."
On screen: *Monday. Honest truth?*

**0:03–0:09 — Last week: the lying-down photo, then 1 second of Deadly Dozen footage.**
Voiceover: "Last week my body pulled the handbrake. A week out of the office."
On screen: *Last week.*

**0:09–0:17 — Catch-up, quick cuts every 1.5–2 seconds: laptop opening, phone buzzing, calendar from a distance (not readable), walking into the office.**
Voiceover: "So this week is catch-up. Inbox. Meetings. Everything that waited."

**0:17–0:28 — Your method: kettle, grind, pour with the Coastal bag in frame. Then the notebook, overhead, writing three things by hand.**
Voiceover: "So I'm keeping it simple. First cup. Three things on paper. One at a time."
On screen: *1. 2. 3.* appearing as you write. Write your real three, e.g. "Clear the urgent. Team catch-up. Rehab session."

**0:28–0:33 — The tease: out the door, keys, car or office lift.**
Voiceover: "There's fun stuff on the horizon."
On screen: *More soon.*

**0:33–0:40 — To camera again, different spot (car or desk), small smile.**
"Time to get after it."
On screen: *More life. Less excuses.*

## Shoot list
- [ ] Tonight: notebook overhead, writing three things
- [ ] Tonight: laptop opening, phone buzzing, calendar from a distance
- [ ] Morning: opening line to camera (3 takes)
- [ ] Morning: kettle, grind, pour with the Coastal bag
- [ ] Morning: out the door, keys, car or lift
- [ ] Morning: closing line to camera (3 takes)
- [ ] Have ready: lying-down photo and Deadly Dozen clip

## Edit
- [ ] Open on your face at frame one, no intro
- [ ] Burned-in captions for every spoken line
- [ ] Music low under the voice (about 15%)
- [ ] Cover frame: you to camera, "Monday. Honest truth?"
- [ ] No confidential work details visible

## Before posting
- [ ] Keep it at "overwhelming", not "burnt out"
- [ ] Post at 10:00 and reply to comments in the first hour

## The idea
First race in months I'm watching, not running. Show up anyway, in the Move Club's corner. Honest, not sad.

2. **The crew before the start:** Move Club shirts, a team photo, quick hellos.
3. **Start line:** the gun or countdown, 5 seconds.
4. **Out on the course:** cheering from the side, 2–3 short clips.
5. **Finish line:** team members finishing, high fives, medals.
6. **To camera, after.** "Different kind of hard, watching from the side. Proud of this crew."
7. **Sign-off:** "More life. Less excuses." Add a question sticker: "How do you stay in it when you're sidelined?"

fields.title: Morning Mission #1: Protect your morning
fields.hook: My day begins long before the sun rises.
fields.script:
## The idea
Protect your morning. The one part of the day that's yours, before the inbox gets a say.

## Format
Reel, 25–30 seconds. Film it Tuesday or Wednesday at sunrise (around 05:15). Walking only: rehab rules apply.

## Script
**0:00–0:03: Dark sky, the beach path, wide.**
On screen: *My day begins long before the sun rises.*

**0:03–0:08: Feet on the sand, walking. Close.**
On screen: *05:15. Before the inbox.*

**0:08–0:15: Flask pour on the beach, the Coastal bag in frame. Steam against the light.**
On screen: *First cup. No phone.*

**0:15–0:21: Sitting, notebook on your knee, writing three things. Sun breaking behind.**
On screen: *Three things. That's it.*

**0:21–0:28: To camera, sun behind you.**
"Protect your morning. It's the one part of the day that's yours."
On screen: *More life. Less excuses.*

## Caption
My day begins long before the sun rises. No phone, first cup, three things on paper. Then the world can have me. What's your non-negotiable morning? ☕🌅
@ccroastersza (paid partnership label if gifted)

1. Sunrise, wide: "Protect your morning."
2. Beach path in the dark: "05:15. Before the inbox."

4. Notebook: "Three things. That's it."

fields.title: Bank: Running changes how you see everything
fields.hook: Most people think running changes their fitness…
fields.script:
## Voiceover (your words)
Most people think running changes their fitness. But really, it changes how you see everything.

People ask me why I love running so much. The answer is simple. It's not just about the training. It's a way to experience the world: places you've never seen, or the same route you've run a thousand times in your home city. Every time, it's something new.

It's not the distance or the pace. It's being immersed in your surroundings in a way only you can experience.

Umhlanga is busy. The chaos, the view. But when you're moving through it, the noise goes quiet. And it's beautiful. Just look around.

It's hard not to enjoy running here. I'm fortunate to call it home.

## Post copy (your words)
Perspective is either a passport or a prison…

When I first started running, I wanted to get into better shape. I thought the biggest change would be my fitness. But it was my perspective and my mindset that changed most.

A new route on the other side of the globe, or the same road I've run 1,000 times: every run offers something unique. A time to reflect and detach, and a chance to experience the world in a different way. A lot of my favourite memories have been on the road, on my own two feet.

I love getting back home. It's one of the best cities to run in: the routes, the views, the people, the community. It doesn't get much better than this.

Running really is my favourite way to immerse myself in the city.

## Shots
- [ ] Umhlanga promenade at first light, wide
- [ ] Moving through the busy bits (traffic, people), then the quiet sea view
- [ ] Feet, breath, the lighthouse

## Timing
Save it for your first run back. Or post it during rehab as "what I miss most", filmed walking.
